text: Phoenix secretary Marion Crane [steals $40,000 from her employer and drives off|trigger|running from trouble] towards her boyfriend, until a rainstorm forces her to stop at the secluded Bates Motel. Its shy proprietor Norman talks over supper about taxidermy, his ailing mother and the private traps people long to escape. Then [a shadowy figure with a kitchen knife|rules|how it hunts] finds her in the shower. Her sister Lila, her lover Sam and a private investigator follow her trail to the motel, where [the house that overlooks it|images|the house and its rooms] keeps [Mrs Bates and her secret|archetypes|The Devouring Mother].
